cards.title: Bures angle and time-local velocity
derived_from: direct differentiation of the pure-initial-state fidelity
cards.numerical_form: excited-state fidelity sqrt(rho_11(t)) and its derivative

checks.reason: The Bures angle and velocity equations are explicit in the source.
Direct differentiation requires rho_t in every time-local factor.
The angle vanishes at t=0 and its cosine remains in [0,1].

open_questions: The first displayed derivative in the source contains rho_tau where direct differentiation requires rho_t; fresh review must classify this notation discrepancy.

checks.reason: The singular-value inequality is printed explicitly.
Direct matrices satisfy the singular-value upper bound.

cards.title: Closed-system operator-norm ML bound
cards.numerical_form: positive 2x2 H and noncommuting pure rho counterexample to the intermediate trace-norm identity

checks.reason: The bound and disputed intermediate equality are explicit in the source.
For H=diag(1,2), rho=|+><+|, ||H rho||_tr=sqrt(2.5) while Tr(H rho)=1.5.
The equality is recovered when H and rho commute.

open_questions: Eq. (10) claims ||H rho||_tr=<H> for positive H without stating the required commutation condition; fresh review must judge the impact on the reduction.

cards.title: Open-system Margolus--Levitin bound
cards.numerical_form: time averages of operator and trace norms of dot(rho)

checks.reason: The open-system ML bound is printed explicitly.
Direct SVD of dot(rho) reproduces both norm factors at every cross-check point.

cards.title: Open-system Mandelstam--Tamm bound
cards.numerical_form: time average of the Frobenius norm of dot(rho)

checks.reason: The Hilbert--Schmidt bound is printed explicitly.
For diagonal dot(rho), the HS norm is sqrt(2) times the operator norm.

cards.title: Unified QSL and Schatten hierarchy
cards.numerical_form: three QSL curves and pointwise hierarchy checks

checks.reason: The unified bound and Schatten hierarchy are printed explicitly.
Every gamma-grid row obeys tau_op >= tau_hs >= tau_tr.

cards.title: Damped Jaynes--Cummings generator and Lorentzian bath
cards.latex: L_t(rho)=gamma_t[sigma_- rho sigma_+ - {sigma_+sigma_-,rho}/2]; J(omega)=gamma_0 lambda/[2 pi((omega_0-omega)^2+lambda^2)]

checks.reason: The generator, spectral density and ladder definition are explicit in the source.
The standard ladders (sigma_x +/- i sigma_y)/2 yield the printed survival solution; the literal printed ladders multiply the dissipator by four.

open_questions: The source defines sigma_pm without the conventional factor 1/2 although the solution uses the conventional normalization.

cards.title: Exact Lorentzian survival amplitude
cards.latex: G(t)=exp(-lambda t/2)[cosh(dt/2)+(lambda/d)sinh(dt/2)], d=sqrt(lambda^2-2 gamma_0 lambda); rho_11=|G|^2
cards.numerical_form: regularized sinhc formula and independent DOP853 pseudomode integration

checks.reason: The rate and reduced density solution are printed explicitly.
Analytic amplitude matches the independent pseudomode ODE over weak, critical, and strong coupling.
The implementation is finite at gamma_0=lambda/2 and exactly normalized at t=0.

cards.title: Markovian plateau and non-Markovian speedup

source_refs.value: paper-source/openqsl_final.tex, Eq. label 33 and surrounding paragraphs

cards.numerical_form: Markovian reference curve, plateau limit, and strong-coupling variation excess

checks.reason: The Markovian average norm and speedup discussion are explicit in the source.
The operator bound approaches tau and the other two plateau at tau/sqrt(2) and tau/2.
Strong coupling produces total variation above the monotonic Markov reference and lowers the operator QSL.
